meta_description: Bathrooms 2 Boilers is your trusted plumber in Wolverhampton. Emergency repairs, boiler installation, and bathroom work. Same-day service available.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 2am? Boiler broken in winter? We're here within the hour, any day of the week.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Wolverhampton
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to new bathroom suites and boiler installation, we handle every plumbing job with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes & Leaks
services.desc: Water damage can't wait. We locate and repair leaks fast, minimising damage to your home. Call us day or night — we're on standby.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: New boiler fitted or existing unit on the blink? We install Worcester, Vaillant, and Baxi models, and repair most makes within hours of your call.

services.title: Full Bathroom Renovation
services.desc: Tired of that tired old suite? We design, supply, and install complete bathrooms — tiling, plumbing, and electrics all handled in-house.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Replace your old heating system with a modern, efficient setup. We'll survey your property, advise on the best option, and install it within days.

services.title: Radiator Repair & Bleeding
services.desc: Cold radiators or noisy pipes disrupting your home? We diagnose faults, bleed air locks, and repair or replace failed units quickly.

services.title: Kitchen Plumbing & Tap Fitting
services.desc: Dripping taps, blocked drains, or new tap installation — we fix kitchen plumbing problems and fit modern kitchen suites from design to completion.

about_pullquote: I started this business fixing what other plumbers left broken.
about_para_1: Bathrooms 2 Boilers was founded on one simple idea: do the job right the first time and treat every customer like a neighbour. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation across Wolverhampton for turning up on time, diagnosing faults honestly, and finishing the work without surprise costs. Our team is Gas Safe registered, fully insured, and trained on the latest heating and plumbing systems.
about_para_2: We're not the cheapest, but we're fair. Customers come back to us because we listen, we explain what's wrong in plain English, and we don't recommend work you don't need. Whether it's a 2am emergency or a planned bathroom refurbishment, you'll get the same level of care and expertise.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a burst pipe on a Sunday evening. Called Bathrooms 2 Boilers in desperation and they were here within 50 minutes. Fixed it, cleaned up, and charged a fair price with no fuss. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Fitted a new bathroom for us last summer. The guys were professional, tidy, and got the job done on time. They sorted out a plumbing issue mid-job without extra charges. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Claire P.

reviews.text: Boiler gave up just before Christmas. Called on the off-chance and they fitted a new Worcester system within two days. Excellent work and they took time to explain how to use it properly. Top job.
reviews.author: David H.
